name: Tomato
kenya_importance: Critical horticultural cash crop grown by smallholders and commercial producers in Kirinyaga (Mwea), Kajiado (Loitokitok), Machakos, Kiambu, and Nakuru.
key_kenya_extension_contacts: Sub-county Agricultural Officer (Horticulture) or KALRO Horticultural Research Institute (Thika).
